nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 token held by the timelock contract.
Immutable beneficiary address that receives released tokens.
Immutable start timestamp of the release period, day-aligned.
End timestamp of the release period; mutable, rewritten on terminate().
Total benefit amount tracked by the contract; mutable, rewritten on terminate().
Running total of amounts already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating whether the contract has been terminated by the owner.
Initializes token, beneficiary, day-aligned release window, total benefit and flags; requires release end after block.timestamp.
View computing the currently releasable balance from block.timestamp and the release window.
View returning _totalBenefit minus releasedBalance().
Public function that transfers the newly released amount to the beneficiary and updates _withdrawedBalance.
Only-owner function that closes the schedule, clamps the release end time to today and sweeps unreleased tokens to the owner.
View returning the held token address.
View returning the beneficiary address.
View returning the total benefit amount.
View returning the already withdrawn balance.
Block timestamp used for release-window math and in terminate() day alignment.
Caller identity used through Ownable._msgSender for the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
External token transfer of the computed amount to the beneficiary; performs an untrusted ERC20 call.
External token transfer of the residual unreleased amount to the owner; performs an untrusted ERC20 call.
Unsigned subtraction token().balanceOf(this) - (_totalBenefit - _withdrawedBalance) used to size the owner payout.
Pro-rata arithmetic (_totalBenefit * passedDays) / totalDays in releasedBalance().
Constructor parameter assigned to _token.
Constructor parameter assigned to _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter that is day-aligned and stored in _releaseStartTime.
Constructor parameter (in days) used to derive _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter assigned to _totalBenefit.
Local amount = releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance transferred to the beneficiary.
Local residual token balance paid out to the owner on termination.
Local number of full days elapsed since _releaseStartTime.
Local total number of days in the release window used as denominator.

edges.reason: token_ constructor parameter is consumed by the constructor.
Constructor writes token_ into state variable _token.
beneficiary_ constructor parameter is consumed by the constructor.
Constructor writes beneficiary_ into state variable _beneficiary.
releaseStartTime_ constructor parameter is day-aligned by the constructor.
Constructor writes the aligned releaseStartTime_ into _releaseStartTime.
daysOfTimelock_ constructor parameter feeds the release end time computation.
Constructor computes and writes _releaseEndTime from the start time and days of timelock.
totalBenefit_ constructor parameter is consumed by the constructor.
Constructor writes totalBenefit_ into state variable _totalBenefit.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency on deployment.
releasedBalance() reads _releaseStartTime for the elapsed-days computation.
releasedBalance() reads _releaseEndTime to bound the schedule and derive totalDays.
releasedBalance() reads _totalBenefit to pro-rate the vested amount.
releasedBalance() branches on block.timestamp, making the released amount timestamp dependent.
releasedBalance() performs the multiplication/division (_totalBenefit * passedDays) / totalDays inside the arithmetic operation node.
Local passedDays feeds the pro-rata arithmetic in releasedBalance().
Local totalDays is the denominator of the pro-rata arithmetic in releasedBalance().
unreleasedBalance() reads _totalBenefit in its subtraction.
unreleasedBalance() computes _totalBenefit - releasedBalance(), an arithmetic operation.
withdraw() calls releasedBalance() for its release check and amount computation.
withdraw() reads _withdrawedBalance to compute the new amount.
withdraw() mutates _withdrawedBalance += amount before the transfer.
withdraw() uses _beneficiary as the transfer recipient.
withdraw() uses _token via token() for the balance check and transfer.
Local amount is the value passed into the token transfer of withdraw().
The withdraw amount is derived from releasedBalance() minus _withdrawedBalance, an arithmetic dataflow into the transfer.
withdraw() invokes the safeTransfer external token call.
safeTransfer makes an untrusted ERC20 external call after the _withdrawedBalance state update, establishing the checks-effects-interactions relationship for reentrancy review.
terminate() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender to owner().
terminate() clamps _releaseEndTime using block.timestamp, introducing timestamp dependence.
terminate() is guarded by isNotTerminated which reads _isTerminated.
terminate() assigns releasedBalance() into _totalBenefit.
terminate() overwrites _totalBenefit with the released balance.
terminate() overwrites _releaseEndTime with the day-aligned current time.
terminate() sets _isTerminated to true.
_totalBenefit is an operand of the subtraction used to size the owner payout.
_withdrawedBalance is an operand of the subtraction used to size the owner payout.
terminate() performs the unsigned balance arithmetic that produces amountToWithdraw.
Local amountToWithdraw is the value transferred to the owner in terminate().
The computed residual balance flows from the arithmetic into the owner transfer.
terminate() invokes the safeTransfer external token call for the owner.
safeTransfer performs an external ERC20 call from terminate(), which must be evaluated against the owner-sweep state updates for reentrancy.
token() returns _token.
beneficiary() returns _beneficiary.
totalBenefit() returns _totalBenefit.
withdrawedBalance() returns _withdrawedBalance.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ has no independent behavior; it is immediately assigned to state variable _token inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is only used to initialize _beneficiary inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is only day-aligned and stored into _releaseStartTime by the constructor.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ is only used to derive _releaseEndTime within the constructor.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is only assigned to state variable _totalBenefit inside the constructor.
Local amount exists solely as the value argument of the safeTransfer call in withdraw().
Local amountToWithdraw exists solely as the value argument of the safeTransfer call in terminate().
Local passedDays is an intermediate operand of the pro-rata arithmetic expression in releasedBalance().
Local totalDays is an intermediate operand (denominator) of the pro-rata arithmetic expression in releasedBalance().
